entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hama Arba Diallo was a Burkinabé politician, diplomat and civil servant. He was minister of foreign affairs of Upper Volta from 1983 to 1984. Diallo, an opponent of President Blaise Compaoré, stood as a candidate in the 2010 presidential election.
